details:
This update for aws-nitro-enclaves-cli fixes the following issues:
  
- CVE-2026-93599: rustls-webpki: Denial of service via panic on malformed CRL BIT STRING (bsc#1282250).
- CVE-2026-93600: rustls-webpki: URI name constraint bypass in X.509 certificates (bsc#1282250).
- CVE-2026-93601: rustls-webpki: DNS name constraint bypass for wildcard certificates (bsc#1282250).
- CVE-2026-93602: rustls-webpki: CRL revocation check bypass via faulty distributionPoint matching (bsc#1282250).
- serde_with: KeyValueMap serialization panics on empty sequence or map entries (bsc#1271853).

Changes for aws-nitro-enclaves-cli:

- Updated to version 1.5.2.
